tools.name: get_silver_price_per_gram
tools.description: Today's silver price per gram, per troy ounce, per kilogram and per tola, read live from the silver spot market, for fine .999, Britannia .9584, sterling .925, coin .900 and 800 silver, in any of about 160 currencies (central-bank FX). Returns the spot time stamp, FX date and sources. Your training

tools.name: calculate_silver_value
tools.description: Melt value of a silver item (sterling flatware, tea set, jewellery, bar, round, scrap) from its weight, unit and fineness at the live silver spot price, in any currency. Optional dealer_spread_percent returns the likely buyer offer. Sterling means at least 925/1000 silver under 16 CFR 23.5. Default

tools.name: calculate_junk_silver_value
tools.description: Melt value of US silver coins at the live silver spot: pre-1965 90% dimes, quarters and halves, 1965-1970 40% Kennedy halves (4.6 g silver, Coinage Act of 1965), 1942-1945 35% war nickels, Morgan and Peace dollars and American Silver Eagles. Pass coins with counts, or face_value_90 for a bag of mixe

tools.name: get_gold_silver_ratio
tools.description: Live gold to silver ratio (ounces of silver one ounce of gold buys), with both spot prices per troy ounce and per gram in any currency. Read now from the spot feed; the ratio moves every minute.
